feature.impl.movement.elytrabooster: Boosts firework acceleration while flying with an elytra.
feature.impl.misc.streamermode: Streamer mode to keep the server off-stream: replaces the server name across all text (chat, menus, scoreboard), rewrites ads to a FunTime version, hides other players' skins behind random ones, and removes clutter scoreboard lines.
feature.impl.hud.networktest: Shows the sadnes server connection status and ping.
marker.beta.note: This module is in beta and still being worked on — expect bugs, unstable behavior and setting changes.
marker.danger.note: Risky module: using it may get you banned on the listed servers.
options.inactivityFpsLimit.never.tooltip: FPS is never limited — even when the window is minimized or you're inactive.
feature.impl.misc.antiafk: Triggers when the game considers you inactive (AFK). Actions are configured separately.

config.placeholder.name: Config name
config.share.export.title: Share config
config.share.import.title: Import config
config.edit.title: Edit config
feature.impl.hud.notification.notificati: Stack of single-line toasts: new ones appear on top and push older ones down; each lives for «Duration» then disappears. Draggable HUD element.
category.combat.desc: Combat: aura, crits, hitboxes, auto-totem and in-combat inventory handling.
category.movement.desc: Movement: speed, strafe assist, bypasses and water/wall traversal.
category.player.desc: Player: through-wall interaction and world click control.
category.visuals.desc: Visuals: entity ESP, player transparency, camera settings and world styling.
category.misc.desc: Misc: trackers, nick protection, auto-join, inventory utilities and Discord RPC.
category.interface.desc: Interface: HUD elements, watermark, module list and config manager.
feature.impl.combat.attackaura:
Automatically locks onto and attacks the nearest targets within range.

- «Aim type» sets the rotation style: Normal, FunTime, Matrix, Snaps and LegitSnap for different servers.
- «Sort mode» picks the target — by Distance, Health, Aim or Adaptive.
- «Correction mode» adjusts movement toward the target: Subtle or Targeted.
- Crits, auto mace, shield breaking and sync with attack are in the «Misc» block.
feature.impl.combat.aimassist: Gently eases your aim toward the target along a curve you define.
feature.impl.combat.aimbot:
Automatically aims at the nearest target and lands hits with the bow, crossbow and trident, leading the target's movement.

- «Weapons» — which weapons the aim works with.
- «Aim distance» — maximum target lock range.
- «FOV» — the view angle within which a target is chosen.
- «Extrapolation ticks» — extra target lead on top of automatic ping compensation.
- «Automatic fire» — releases the shot on full charge by itself.
feature.impl.combat.autototem:
Automatically places a totem of undying into the offhand when health drops below a threshold.

- «Health level» — the HP threshold below which the totem is grabbed.
- «Checks for» enable proactive reactions: crystals, TNT, trident, mace, respawn anchor and fall.
- «Swap back» returns the previous offhand item after the totem is placed.
- «Keep enchanted» preserves enchanted totems while regular ones are available.
feature.impl.combat.criticals:
Delivers a critical hit on every attack.

- «Mode» — the working option for your server: «Grim 1.17+ Air» crits in mid-air, «NCP+» crits from the ground, «Macespoof» lands a strong mace blow while standing on the ground.
feature.impl.combat.autoswap:
Quickly swap items into your offhand. Two modes selectable in «Mode»:

- «Normal» — «Key» swaps between two chosen items («Item» and «Swap to»): totem, shield, gapples or ball. «Ignore unenchanted» keeps enchanted totems.
- «Wheel» — up to 5 favorite items: a short press of «Key» swaps between them, holding opens a radial wheel (release on an item to swap, LMB to open your inventory and add items).

«Notify on swap» shows a popup when the item changes.
feature.impl.combat.autocart:
On keybind places a rail on the target block, places a TNT minecart and shoots it with a flame bow — all in one press.

- Requires in hotbar: rail, TNT minecart and a bow with Flame.
- «Activation key» sets the trigger button.
feature.impl.combat.autopotion:
Automatically throws a splash potion at your feet when a needed effect is missing or health falls below the threshold.

- «Potions» selects which effects to manage: strength, speed, fire resistance, healing, regeneration.
- «Healing health» — the instant-restore threshold.
- «Regeneration trigger» — throw regen only when the effect is absent or below a set HP.
- «Only on ground» prevents throwing potions while airborne.
feature.impl.combat.autogapple:
Automatically eats a golden apple from the offhand when health drops below the threshold.

- «Health» — the HP threshold to start eating.
- «Delay (ms)» — pause between repeated uses.
- «Count absorption» includes absorption hearts in the HP calculation.
feature.impl.combat.autouse:
Eats food when hungry and keeps invisibility up.

- «Modes» — what to enable: «Food» and «Invisibility».
- «Hunger level» — eat at or below this hunger (picks the most filling food).
- «Invisibility» — «Auto drink» tops up the invisibility potion before it ends, «Notify on end» warns once that the effect is about to wear off.
feature.impl.combat.hitbox:
Expands player and mob hitboxes to make hitting them easier. Does not shift nametags or boxes — anchoring ESP to the head stays safe.

- «Targets» — who to expand the hitbox for.
- «Players size» / «Mobs size» — how much to expand.
- Does not apply to friends.
feature.impl.combat.triggerbot:
Automatically attacks the target under your crosshair, no clicking needed.

- «Targets» pick who it triggers on: players, mobs, animals.
- «Attack range» limits the reach.
- «Reaction delay» adds a random pause before the hit — looks more natural.
- «Crits only» and «Smart crits» strike at the crit moment.
feature.impl.combat.velocitycontrol:
Cancels knockback from hits and explosions, keeping you in place.

- «From hits» — don't get knocked back by incoming damage.
- «From explosions» — don't get pushed by blast waves.
- «Bypass type» — the working option for your server.
feature.impl.movement.timer:
Speeds up all your actions and movement.

- «Speed» — how much faster than normal: 1.0 is normal, 3.0 is maximum.
feature.impl.movement.noslow:
Removes slowdown from eating, sneaking and crawling.

- «Remove slowdowns» lets you choose what to keep full speed for: «Food», «Sneaking», «Crawling».
- «Eating bypass» — the working option for your server.
- «Sneak bypass» — the working option for your server.
- «Allow fall while sneaking» — enable it if the server otherwise causes issues.
feature.impl.movement.jesus:
Lets you walk on water without sinking.

- «Type» — the working option for your server.
feature.impl.movement.sprint:
Automatically holds sprint even when vanilla would cancel it.

- «Sprint while hungry» allows sprinting at low hunger.
- «Keep sprint on hit» maintains sprint after hitting an entity.
feature.impl.movement.guiwalk:
Lets you move and jump with screens open (inventory, ClickGUI).

- «Bypass anticheats» — safely move items while on the move on protected servers.
- «All containers» — move items not only in your own inventory, but also in chests and other containers.
feature.impl.movement.nopush:
Blocks selected types of player pushing.

- «Pushes» lets you enable protection by category: «Blocks», «Water», «Bubbles», «Entities», «Fishing rod», «World border».
feature.impl.movement.movementhelper:
Automatically jumps or sneaks at block edges to prevent falling.

- «Edge actions» enables the automatic action when a drop is detected.
- «Action» picks the response: «Jump» (auto-jump before the edge) or «Sneak» (crouch when a drop is underfoot).
- «Only when moving backwards» restricts sneaking to cases of backward movement or standing still.
- «Block threshold» sets the distance from the edge at which auto-jump triggers.
feature.impl.movement.spider:
Lets you climb vertical walls by holding jump.

- «Mode» — the working climb option for your server: «Funtime» is smooth, «Matrix» is fast.
feature.impl.movement.fastladder: Speeds up climbing and descending ladders and vines.
feature.impl.movement.speed:
Speeds up movement on the ground.

- «Mode» — the acceleration option for your server: «NCP», «Matrix JB», «Grim Entity», «Grim Entity 2».
- «Timer» — additionally speeds up movement (NCP and Matrix JB modes).
- «Pause» — suspends the boost «In liquids» or «While sneaking».
feature.impl.movement.airstuck:
Holds you in mid-air in place.

- «Alternative mode» — enable it if you get kicked from the server by timeout.
feature.impl.movement.elytrarecast: Automatically takes off with an elytra while moving: jumps from the ground and starts flight instantly in the air.
feature.impl.movement.flight:
Lets you fly freely through the air.

- "Horizontal speed" — how fast you move horizontally.
- "Vertical speed" — how fast you rise and descend.
- "Air stop" — hover in place and stop falling while you are not moving.
feature.impl.movement.strafe: Omni-strafe: lets you accelerate and keep your movement speed in any direction, including strafing sideways and backwards, without losing momentum.
feature.impl.player.fastbreak: Speeds up block breaking so you mine faster than usual.
feature.impl.player.nointeract:
Blocks accidental right-clicks during combat so you don't interact with the wrong thing.

- «What to block» — choose clicks on blocks and/or on entities.
- «Entity clicks» — e.g. lets you eat a chorus fruit instead of mounting a minecart.
- «Only with AttackAura» — blocking is only active while AttackAura is enabled.
feature.impl.player.autotool: Automatically switches the hotbar tool to the optimal one for breaking the block under the crosshair, returning to the slot after mining ends. For leaves it considers swords.
feature.impl.player.clickaction:
Quick item use on keybind and friend-list management by clicking.

- «Pearl key» — throw an ender pearl.
- «XP key» — throw an XP bottle (with auto-aim downward).
- «Crossbow key» — fire a crossbow.
- «Add friend» — add/remove the looked-at player from the friends list.
feature.impl.player.openwalls: Opens containers (chests, barrels, etc.) through blocks in your line of sight while holding right-click.
feature.impl.player.airplace:
Lets you place blocks in mid-air along your line of sight without needing an adjacent block.

- «Range» — maximum placement distance (1–6 blocks).
feature.impl.player.nodelay:
Removes delays between player actions.

- «Jumps» — resets the cooldown between jumps.
- «Right click» — removes the item re-use delay.
feature.impl.player.autorespawn: Automatically respawns you right after death, skipping the death screen.
feature.impl.player.autorelease:
Releases charging items exactly at full charge, so you don't have to hold them.

- «Bow» — fires at full draw.
- «Crossbow» — finishes charging at the optimal moment.
- «Trident» — throws at full wind-up.
feature.impl.misc.tracker:
Tracks nearby players' actions and reports them in chat.

- «Track what» — splash potion effects, item pickup, dropped totem, low HP, armor durability, potion effects, what a player ate, player leave.
- «HP threshold» — health level at which a warning is shown; «HUD alert» enables a red vignette on screen edges.
- «Durability percent» — armor wear threshold for a warning.
- «Warn seconds before» — lead time before a potion expires.
feature.impl.misc.nofrienddamage: Prevents you from hitting players on your friends list.
feature.impl.misc.norotationbreak: Keeps the camera smooth during server repositioning so your view does not snap.
feature.impl.misc.discordrpc:
Shows the client's activity in your Discord profile.

- «Show server» — display the server name in the status.
- «Session time» — show a timer for the current game session.
feature.impl.misc.elytraswap:
Quickly swaps your chestplate for an elytra and back with one press.

- «Swap key» — key to toggle between chestplate and elytra.
- «Firework» — key to use a firework while flying with an elytra.
feature.impl.misc.serverassist:
Assistant for FunTime, HolyWorld and ReallyWorld servers: item keybinds and server utilities.

- «Server» — select the active server: FunTime, HolyWorld or ReallyWorld.
- «FT utilities» — auto event point, trap detection, auto /event delay.
- «HW utilities» — auto-loot lockpicks, trap detection with sound and 3D markers.
- «Use on bind» — assign keys for server items (potions, traps, special items).
feature.impl.misc.containerstealer:
Automatically moves items from an opened container to your inventory.

- «Loot order» — pickup order: from start, from end or random.
- «Loot type» — normal (with delay) or FunTime (by gunpowder cooldown).
- «Loot delay» — pause between moves in normal mode.
- «Close if empty» — automatically close the container when everything has been taken.
feature.impl.misc.itemscroller:
Quickly moves items in containers by dragging with the button held.

- «Scroller delay» — pause between item moves.
feature.impl.misc.lockslot:
Protects items in chosen hotbar slots from being dropped by accident.

- «Slots» — hotbar slot numbers (1–9) to protect.
- «Only in PvP» — protection works only during combat.
- «Include inventory» — also blocks dropping and picking the item from a protected slot when clicking in the inventory.
feature.impl.misc.autoaccept:
Automatically accepts incoming teleport requests sent to you.

- «Only friends» — accept requests only from players on your friends list.
feature.impl.misc.autofish:
Automatically reels in the catch and recasts the rod — just cast it once.

- «Recast delay» — pause before recasting after a bite.
feature.impl.misc.ancientesp:
Highlights ancient debris through walls.

- «Color» — block highlight color.
feature.impl.misc.autoleave:
Automatically leaves the server in dangerous situations to save your gear and avoid dying.

- «Leave method» — disconnect from the server or run a command.
- «Leave reasons» — when to trigger: a player nearby, after combat, or on low health.
feature.impl.render.boxesp:
Highlights selected blocks and entities through walls — handy for finding ores, containers or specific mobs. The target list is managed with the .boxesp command.

- «Color» — highlight color for the boxes.
- «Style» — highlight shape: fade, corners or frame.
feature.impl.render.partyesp: Shows party members who are currently too far away to be loaded right in your ESP. Their box, name, glow, chams, armor and items follow the «Friends» settings of the Esp module — so Esp itself must be enabled. Once a teammate is nearby again, the regular ESP takes over.
feature.impl.render.arrows:
Displays animated arrows around your crosshair pointing toward players and other targets near you. Helps you keep track of those who moved off-screen: the arrow smoothly appears, rotates with your camera, and can change size and color based on distance.

- "Targets" — which targets to mark with arrows.
- "Color" — client color, rainbow, by distance, or a custom color per category.
- "Only off-screen" — hide the arrow when the target is already visible on screen.
feature.impl.render.previews: Shows the contents of bundles and shulker boxes: point your cursor at one and hold the bound key to see a grid of the items inside. Works both in open containers and in the world — on dropped items and placed blocks.
feature.impl.render.prediction:
Shows where thrown projectiles will land — both the item in your hand and projectiles already flying in the world. Draws the flight path, marks the landing spot and, for flying projectiles, shows the time left until impact.

- «From hand» — predict the throw of the item you are holding.
- «Flying projectiles» — which in-world projectiles to track.
- «Line» — draw the trajectory line.
- «Landing marker» — mark the landing spot with a box.
- «Info plate» — show the item/time plate at the landing spot.
- «Color» — color of the line and marker.
- «Line width» — thickness of the trajectory line.
- «Target highlight» — when the predicted throw is about to hit a mob or player, that entity's hitbox and the trajectory are highlighted.
- «Highlight color» — the color of that highlight.
prediction.label: Info plate
feature.impl.misc.joiner:
Automatically connects to a server or joins anarchy.

- «Joiner type» — ST Duels (opens the mode menu and picks duels) or FT/ST Anarchy (sends a command to enter anarchy).
- «Anarchy number» — anarchy number to auto-join.
feature.impl.misc.freecam:
Detaches the camera from the player, letting you fly freely around the world.

- «Speed» — movement speed of the free camera.
feature.impl.misc.clientspoof:
Spoofs client settings sent to the server and hides your nickname and friends' nicknames behind replacement text.

- «Replace settings» — enables spoofing of client settings.
- «Spoof» — language, render distance, chat, chat colors, skin, main hand, text filter, server listing, particles.
- «Replace name» — hide your nickname behind replacement text.
- «Replacement» — the text used to replace nicknames.
- «Hide friends» — extend the replacement to nicknames on the friends list.
- Values are tied to the username: for a given account they remain the same across sessions.
feature.impl.render.transparentplayers:
Makes players more transparent the closer they are to you.

- «Distance» — the radius in which the effect begins: at the boundary a player is fully opaque, up close they are maximally transparent.
feature.impl.render.testrender: A service render benchmark: performance test for UI primitives and nametags.
feature.impl.render.seeinvisibles:
Shows invisible players at a set transparency.

- «Transparency» — how visible invisible players are (as a percentage of full opacity).
feature.impl.render.removals:
Removes intrusive visual and audio elements from the game.

- «Elements» — choose what to hide: fire, camera shake, boss bar, player glow, enchant glint, bad effects, black hearts, scoreboard, totem/hand animation, block particles, hand bob while eating, sounds.
- «Remove sound» — targeted muting of individual sounds: event spawn, wither on hit, trident, XP bottle, thunder.
feature.impl.render.cameratweaks:
Lets you change the behaviour of the in-game camera.

- «Disable 3rd-person collision» — the camera passes through blocks and doesn't clip to the player's back.
- «Camera distance» — distance from the player to the third-person camera (active while collision is disabled).
feature.impl.render.aspectratio:
Stretches or squeezes the world image to a chosen aspect ratio. The familiar «stretched» format makes player models wider and easier to read in close combat.

- «Aspect ratio» — pick the picture format to suit your monitor and play style.
feature.impl.render.freelook: Look around freely in third person without turning your character — handy for watching your surroundings while moving or fighting.
feature.impl.render.auctionhelper:
Highlights the cheapest and best-value-per-unit lot on the auction.

- «Cheapest item» — highlight color for the lot with the lowest price.
- «Best value item» — highlight color for the lot with the best price per unit.
- «Find item on auction» — keybind: searches the auction for the item you are holding.
feature.impl.render.esp:
Displays ESP information about world entities: box, glow, chams, health bar, armor and nametag.

- Configured separately for each category: regular players, friends, naked, animals, mobs, items and self.
- For each category the available elements are: box (2D/3D), glow, chams, health, armor, nametag.
feature.impl.render.hitcolor:
Changes the color of the damage flash on entities.

- «Color» — the color that replaces the default red hurt flash.
feature.impl.render.particles:
A swarm of 3D particles from selected events: world, hits, totem, movement, projectiles, death.

- «Render as» — particle shape: textures, boxes, glow boxes, fluff or random.
- «Textures» — sprite selection: dot, star, heart, dollar, snowflake, pumpkin, logo.
- «Color mode» — client accent, custom color, rainbow (or totem color for the totem event).
- Each event has its own group with physics settings: gravity, speed, collision behaviour.
feature.impl.render.hand.handglow: Adds a glow around your held item and hand — a soft «Bloom» halo or an upward «Flame». Color, intensity and radius are configurable.
feature.impl.render.hand.swinganimation: Replaces the swing animation with one of the presets (Swipe, Down, Smooth, Power, Feast, Akrien, Tap, Squeeze) for swords. Speed and strength are adjustable.
feature.impl.render.hand.handoffset: Manually shifts the position of the main and off hand along the X/Y/Z axes.
feature.impl.render.ambience:
Changes the world atmosphere: sky, fog, clouds, lighting, time of day and weather.

- «Time» — fixes the time of day (0–24 h).
- «Weather» — forced weather: clear, rain, thunder or snow.
- Sky, fog, cloud and lighting profiles can be configured globally or separately for each dimension (overworld, nether, end, spawn, hub).
feature.impl.hud.cooldowns: Shows item and offhand cooldowns as chips with an icon and countdown.
feature.impl.hud.serverbinds:
Server item-bind HUD (HolyWorld, ReallyWorld, FunTime): icon, count, key; a colored countdown timer during cooldown.

- «Orientation» — «Vertical»: chips in a column; «Horizontal»: chips in a row.
- «Single line» — in horizontal mode removes line wrapping (only available for «Horizontal»).
feature.impl.hud.keybinds: List of active module and setting binds with their key and state. Module binds show a toggle icon, value binds show the current value.
feature.impl.hud.modulelist: List of active modules in the corner of the screen.
feature.impl.hud.potions: Shows active potion effects and remaining time. PvP effects (strength, speed, fire resistance, etc.) are listed first; harmful ones are highlighted in red.
feature.impl.hud.stafflist:
Server moderation list: shows online staff, spectators and vanished players.

- «Online» — staff visible in the tab with a rank prefix.
- «Vanish» — moderation with a prefix whose name does not appear in the tab.
- «Spectator (GM3)» — all players in spectator mode.
feature.impl.hud.clickgui: Opens the client's main menu on key press.
feature.impl.hud.targethud:
Info about the current target: head, nickname, health bar and equipment.

- «Show armor» — displays the target's equipped armor in a row between the nick and bar.
- «Show on look» — shows the TargetHud when looking at a living player without an aimbot.
- «Hit particles» — a particle burst from the target's head on every hit.
- «Eating particles» — crumbs from the mouth area while the target eats or drinks a potion.
feature.impl.hud.mediaplayer:
Now-playing widget: cover art, track name, artist, progress slider and controls. Data is pulled from Windows SMTC (any media player).

- «Blur» — blurs the background behind the widget.
- Controls (prev/play/next) appear on hover.
- Volume — mouse wheel over the widget.
feature.impl.hud.inventory:
Player inventory as a grid of chips: 3 rows of the main inventory and (optionally) the hotbar. In ClickGUI items can be dragged between slots.

- «Header» — «Static»: width for the title; «Dynamic»: stretches to the grid width.
- «Show hotbar» — adds a fourth row with the hotbar below the main inventory.
- «Show count» — stack count in the bottom-right corner of the chip.
feature.impl.hud.watermark.watermark:
Client watermark on screen with a configurable set of chips.

- Each chip can be toggled individually: logo, avatar, nick, FPS, time, coords, speed, ping, IP, TPS, CPU, RAM, GPU, K/D, CPU Freq, CPU Cores, Var, Loss, Connectivity, Preset.
- «Position» — screen edge alignment: «Left», «Center», «Right».
- Chip order is changed by dragging in the ClickGUI/chat; a chip is removed with the trash icon.
autoswap.wheel.hint: Release — swap · LMB — add · RMB — remove
feature.impl.movement.blocknormalizer: Makes movement on selected blocks normal: ice isn't slippery, slime and soul sand don't slow you down.
feature.impl.movement.highjump: Lets you jump higher than normal.
serverassist.effect.horus_dragon: Can't eat chorus or throw pearl yet
feature.impl.render.motionblur: Smears the picture in the direction you move the camera for a smoother, more cinematic feel. Higher strength means a longer blur trail.
playermodels.panel.title: Models
feature.impl.hud.hotbar:
Custom hotbar in the client style: a single glass panel with the quick-access items, a smooth highlight on the selected slot, a row of status bars and an optional offhand cell.

- «Overlays» — stack count, durability and item cooldown on the slots.
- «Status bars» — health, hunger, armor, air and experience above the slots.
- «Offhand» — a separate cell for the offhand item next to the bar.
feature.impl.hud.armor:
Equipment and held items: armor (helmet → boots), right and left hand with remaining durability.

- «Show as percent» — durability as a percentage of maximum instead of an absolute value.
- «Chips only» — hides item names, leaving only the icon and durability.
feature.impl.render.fullbright:
Illuminates the world to maximum brightness using the chosen method.

- «Mode» — «Gamma» (raises client gamma) or «Night vision» (night-vision effect).
feature.impl.render.playermodels:
Assigns Figura models to players by ESP category.

- For each category (self, friends, others, naked) you can enable model replacement and choose a folder from the avatar library.

lua.api.sound.play: Play a sound by id (volume and pitch are optional)
lua.api.sound.play_at: Play a positioned sound in the world at given coordinates
lua.api.vector.description: 3D vector: create, add, subtract, scalar multiply, length, distance, normalize, dot product
lua.api.animation.description: Progress animations 0→1: creates a handle with a set duration and easing curve, controlled via :start()/:reset()/:value()/:finished()
lua.api.clipboard.paste: Returns text from the clipboard (or empty string)
lua.api.world.find_blocks: Finds all blocks of a given type in a cube around the player
lua.api.commands.register.description: Register a command with a name and handler function
serverassist.notify.no_empty_slot: No empty slot for bundle extraction!
feature.impl.misc.partypoint: Party markers: hover a spot and place a marker — your whole party will see the point with an icon, name, and distance.
party.point.notInParty: You are not in a party.
